Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one complete full-bleed portrait 2:3 tarot illustration, Three of Swords. The first 2 reference image(s) are exact Dragon Quest character identity/costume references; the LAST is ONLY the approved deck ink/color/texture style, not a scene or person to copy.
Scene and exact characters: Actual Psaro and Rose/Rosalie, using their official DQM3 reference costumes and faces. Psaro silver-haired elf with pointed ears and dark red/black outfit; Rose exact hair, eyes and elf outfit from her sheet. They stand apart beneath a rain cloud, thoughtful and sorrowful but unharmed. In the upper sky, exactly THREE floating steel swords pass through a large symbolic HEART-SHAPED CLOUD. This is a cloud emblem, not an organ; no blades touch either character. Three full swords clearly visible and no other weapons. Gentle melancholic atmosphere, rain giving way to light, fully clothed, no gore/death/injury. Do not copy official page text or layout.
Shared deck art direction: faithfully drawn Akira Toriyama Dragon Quest characters, clean confident black ink outlines, expressive recognizable faces, crisp hand-painted cel color blocks, restrained shadows and a subtle watercolor-paper grain matching the approved illustration. Original illustration, NOT a 3D screenshot, product photograph, plush, collage or card mockup. Full-bleed single cohesive artwork edge to edge, mobile-readable clear silhouettes and large key symbols.
Hard constraints: no title, no typography, no letters or numerals, no UI, no watermark/logo, no borders or card frame. Any writing, decorative labels, copyright line, duplicate background portraits or layout boxes on reference sheets must NOT appear. Preserve actual named DQ characters, hairstyle/clothing/colors, not generic original substitutes. Keep the stated number of tarot objects exact; avoid incidental extra cups/swords/coins/wands. Do not mix in characters from other franchises.
visual_review: Actual Psaro and Rosalie identities match official DQM3 reference variant; exactly three swords through a symbolic heart cloud, none touches people, no injury; no text/frame.
